task: Implement plan section 14 / T13 for SmartTube-AI: two TV-remote-friendly buttons in the existing subtitle menu that export, locally and in the background, (a) a subtitle ZIP built only from the already obtained timeline plus the already cached translations (missing translations fall back to the original and are disclosed, never auto-translated, no paid call, cache limits unchanged) and (b) a desensitised diagnostic report that also works with no timeline, AI off and no key (field whitelist only: no key, Authorization, cookie, account, signed URL, HTTP body or subtitle text). Storage must be a public directory a TV file manager can copy (Documents/SmartTube/Exports), the result must name the real file and location, repeated taps must not duplicate work, and an export in progress must not mix in a later video/track session.

checks.claim: The archive is built from the session state captured when the user pressed the button, so a later video or track change cannot put new session content into the finished file.
The diagnostic report is produced and written even when no timeline was obtained, no key is configured and AI is off.

checks.source: SubtitleDiagnosticReport.build coverage use and counter lines + value()
checks.claim: The diagnostic report cannot contain subtitle text, an API key, an Authorization header, a cookie, a signed URL or an HTTP body, because the only use of the translation map is to count items and every printed value is forced onto one bounded line.
Exporting starts no translation request and neither raises nor consumes the bounded cache limits.
SRT output keeps one cue per displayable frame, drops clearing frames and zero-length frames, and estimates only a final unknown end, so no text is invented and no visible cue is lost.

checks.source: SubtitleExportFileStore media-store and legacy write loops
checks.claim: The export is reported as success only after the stored file length equals the written length, and an existing file with the same name is never overwritten.
A second press while an export is running starts no second job, and the guard is released after success, failure or a refused executor.
